Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__Non-generative brake order_n
Entry.Comment: Order for the axis to brake without generating energy back in the power supply module. Active low

Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__Ready to operate
Entry.Comment: High if no errors, mains voltage between tolerances, dc link loaded and relays closed. It allows the axis to be enabled. If this gets low in operation, the axis do not be disabled but rather it avoids the axis to be enabled again.

Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__TorqueOFF order_n
Entry.Comment: Order for the axis to switch off the torque. Active low

Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__Generative brake order_n
Entry.Comment: Order for the axis to brake generating energy back in the power supply module. Active low

Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__Limit dc link current_order_n
Entry.Comment: Order for the axis to limit the requested current from the DC link. Active low. Cause: Motoric load (6001:0A) greater than 102%.

Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__NC handling_order_n
Entry.Comment: Order for the NC to handle. Active low

Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__Counter
Entry.Comment: Sign for the axis, that the power supply module is in SAFEOP or OP.

Entry.Name: Actual DC link voltage
Entry.Comment: Actual voltage value at the DC link.

Entry.Name: Actual mains voltage
Entry.Comment: Actual RMS-value of mains voltage

Entry.Name: Actual mains current
Entry.Comment: Actual input current in the dc link.

Entry.Name: Actual 24V-supply current
Entry.Comment: Actual total 24V-current of AX8000 bond

Entry.Name: Actual brake resistor continuous power
Entry.Comment: Actual continuous power converted in the brake resistor.

Entry.Name: Actual brake resistor short-time energy
Entry.Comment: Actual brake energy generated in last second in % of maximal short-time energy (by on-time 1s)

Entry.Name: Actual motoric load
Entry.Comment: Actual input load in the dc link in percent of nominal current.

Entry.Name: Warning__A1 Brake resistor power overload
Entry.Comment: Actual brake power or energy above brake resistor power warning threshold (8000:0D). Code on display A0001

Entry.Name: Warning__A2 PCB overtemperature
Entry.Comment: Actual pcb temperature above PCB temperature warning threshold (8000:09). Code on display A0002

Entry.Name: Warning__A3 Heatsink overtemperature
Entry.Comment: Actual heatsink temperature above heatsink temperature warning threshold (8000:0A). Code on display A0003

Entry.Name: Warning__A4 DC link continuous overcurrent
Entry.Comment: DC link current above DC link continuous overcurrent warning threshold (8000:02). Code on display A0004

Entry.Name: Warning__A5 24V-Supply continuous overcurrent
Entry.Comment: 24V-current above 24V-supply continuous overcurrent warning threshold (8000:03). Code on display A0005

Entry.Name: Warning__A6 Fan malfunction
Entry.Comment: Fan does not work. Code on display A0006

Entry.Name: Warning__A7 Mains overvoltage
Entry.Comment: Actual mains voltage above mains voltage max tolerance (8000:07). Code on display A0007

Entry.Name: Warning__A8 Mains undervoltage
Entry.Comment: Actual mains voltage below mains voltage min tolerance (8000:08). Code on display A0008

Entry.Name: Error code
Entry.Comment: This object shall provide the error code of the last error, which occurred in this power supply module.

Entry.Name: DcLink state machine
Entry.Comment: Actual state of the DcLink state machine.

Entry.Name: Umains state machine
Entry.Comment: Actual state of the Umains state machine.

Entry.Name: Data 1
Entry.Comment: Actual value of debug pointer 1.

Entry.Name: Data 2
Entry.Comment: Actual value of debug pointer 2.

Entry.Name: Statusword__Ready to operate
Entry.Comment: High if no errors, mains voltage between tolerances, dc link loaded and relays closed. It allows the axis to be enabled. If this gets low in operation, the axis do not be disabled but rather it avoids the axis to be enabled again.

Entry.Name: Statusword__Error
Entry.Comment: High if any error is set. To know the error look at the Diag-History.

Entry.Name: Statusword__Warning
Entry.Comment: High if any warning is set. To know the warning look at the warning register (6002).

Entry.Name: Statusword__Relays closed
Entry.Comment: High if relays are closed.

Entry.Name: Statusword__Brake chopper active
Entry.Comment: High if brake chopper is switched on.

Entry.Name: Statusword__Fan active
Entry.Comment: High if fan is turning.

Ein fataler Fehler ist aufgetreten, das Gerät muss neu gestartet werden.
A fatal error occured. A device reboot is required.
Das Reset-Kommando (Fault reset) muss ausgeführt werden.
Execute Reset-Command (Fault reset).
Information: Reset nicht erforderlich.
Information: No reset required.

DiagReaction.Text: PSM is not ready to operate
Generative brake ramp order to the axis
Nicht-generative bremsrampe Anforderung an die Achsen
Non-generative brake ramp order to the axis
Torque off Anforderung an die Achsen
Torque off order to the axis
PSM ist nicht betriebsbereit und die Transition PREOP nach SAFEOP wird gesperrt.
PSM is not ready to operate and transition PREOP to SAFEOP disabled

DiagMessage.MessageText: No errors
Continuous over current (device internal), Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u

CauseRemedy.Cause: The whole drive system demands too much current from the 24V-supply.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Sum all following calculated current consumptions. If this exceeds 20 A, change your application or your axis bond.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Too many modules in your axis bond
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check how many modules are in use. Calculate the current consumption of all of them.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Too many motors with motor brake in use.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check how many motors release the motor brake at once. Calculate the current consumption of this.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Continuous over current (device output side), Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The demanded current from axis system exceeds permanently the nominal current by more than 20%.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Your applikation is so designed, that this exceeds permanently the allowed value.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize your application and make that this overcurrent does not happen. E.g. make that not so many motors run with so much current at once. Or use a bigger power supply module.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Peak over current (device output side), Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The demanded current from axis system overloads the power supply module by more than 30%. This happens when a current of two times the nominal current is requested for longer than 5s.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Your applikation is so designed, that this exceeds the maximal allowed current.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize your application and make that this overcurrent does not happen. E.g. make that not so many motors accelerate with so much current at once. Or use a bigger power supply module.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Mains over-voltage, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The actual mains voltage exceeds the parametrized mains voltage (0x8000:06) by more than 20% or by more than the parametrized positive tolerance (0x8000:07), if this higher than 20%.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The actual mains voltage is too high.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Look for a allowed mains voltage.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The positive mains voltage tolerance (0x8000:07) is parametrized too low.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Correct this parametrized value.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Mains under-voltage, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The actual mains voltage is below the parametrized mains voltage (0x8000:06) by more than 30% or by more than the parametrized negative tolerance (0x8000:08), if this higher than 30%.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The actual mains voltage is too low.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Look for a allowed mains voltage.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The negative mains voltage tolerance (0x8000:08) is parametrized too low.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Correct this parametrized value.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Phase failure, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: One phase is failed by 3-phase-supply.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The mains voltage supply is faulty.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analyze the mains voltage supply and resolve the problem.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The mains voltage supply is disturbed over and over.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Activate a filter, which effects, that the phase monitoring waits longer, until this error is set.

CauseRemedy.Cause: You use the power supply module in a one-phase-mains but it is parametrized for three phases. And the module has not recognized the mains type properly.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check the parameter Mains type (0x8000:04) and correct its value. Switch on again the mains voltage.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Mains voltage over brake resistor operating voltage. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The mains voltage has voltage peaks, which makes that the brake chopper gets switched on.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Voltage peaks occur by the mains voltage.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize the mains supply and make, that the voltage peaks do not happen.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The parametrization of DC link max voltage (0x8000:01) is too low.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check your application and parametrize the DC link max voltage higher, if necessary. In this case the switchOn threshold voltage (0x9006:0C) of the brake chopper should has been changed.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Wrong mains type. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The connected mains type (3Ph/AC, 1Ph/AC or DC) does not match with parametrized value of Mains type (0x8000:04).

CauseRemedy.Cause: Mains type (0x8000:04) is parametrized with wrong value.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check the parameter Mains type (0x8000:04) and correct its value.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The mains supply is not connected right.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check the mains suppy and connected it right, Switch on the mains voltage again.

DiagMessage.MessageText: DC link over-voltage, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The DC link voltage rises over the permitted DC link voltage because of power feedback (brake) from the motors.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Your application is so designed, that the permitted DC link voltage is exceeded.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize your application and make, that this overvoltage can not happen.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The parametrization of DC link max voltage (0x8000:01) is too low.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check your application and parametrize the DC link max voltage (0x8000:01) higher, if necessary.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Device DC link over-voltage, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The DC link voltage rises over the permitted maximal DC link voltage because of power feedback (brake) from the motors.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Your application is so designed, that the permitted maximal DC link voltage is exceeded.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize your application and make, that this overvoltage can not happen.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Excess ambient temperature, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The measured ambient temperature from power supply module exceeds the maximal permitted value of 80,0°C.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The temperature in the electrical cabinet is too high.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Make, that the ambient temperature does not exceeds the permitted maximal value. E.g. cooling of electrical cabinet.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Excess temperature device, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The device temperature exceeds the permitted maximal value of 80,0°C.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Your application has produced a thermic overload of the power supply module.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize your application and make, that this thermic overload does not happen.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Read failure eeprom power board. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
Read failure eeprom power board. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: A error by reading data from the eeprom of power board happened by the initialization.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Read failure eeprom option board. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: A error by reading data from the eeprom of option board happened by the initialization.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.Description: A error by reading data from the eeprom of link board happened by the initialization.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Device ids are missing in eeprom
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Missing ids in eeprom power board. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: By the initialization the board ids could not be found in eeprom of power board.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Board ids are missing in eeprom
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Missing ids in eeprom link board. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: By the initialization the board ids could not be found in eeprom of link board.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Board ids are missing in eeprom
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Board ids are missing in eeprom
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Missing factory settings in eeprom. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: By the initialization the factory settings data could not be found in eeprom.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Factory settings are missing in eeprom
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Missing ids in eeprom display board. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: By the initialization the board ids could not be found in eeprom of option board.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Board ids are missing in eeprom
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Read failure eeprom display board. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: A error by reading data from the eeprom of display board happened by the initialization.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Software reset (watchdog), Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: A time out happened.

CauseRemedy.Cause: An unknown software failure happened.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Failure config bits. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: A failure in the internal configuration happened.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The firmware update was not succesfully.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again and start a new firmware update. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Loss of parameters, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: Default values of parameters could not be loaded.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Device ids or power board ids are missing in eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Parameter error. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: A parametrization error happened.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Parameter values are not plausible to each other.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check the parameter values and correct them.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Parameter 0x%x/%x with parametrized 0x%x/%x is too low. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: Value of first parameter is too low by value of second parameter.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Parametrized DC link max voltage (0x8000:01) is too low for parametrized mains voltage (0x8000:06).
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Look at the internal calculated values 0x9006:0C and 0x9006:0E. The first one must be higher than second one. Parametrize 0x8000:01 and 0x8000:06 again, so that this is achieved.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Parameter 0x%x/%x with parametrized 0x%x/%x is too high. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: Value of first parameter is too high by value of second parameter.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Parametrized mains voltage min tolerance (0x8000:08) is too high for parametrized mains voltage (0x8000:06).
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Parametrize 0x8000:08 or 0x8000:06 so that the value of object 0x9006:0F is not exceeded.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Parametrized mains voltage max tolerance (0x8000:07) is too high for parametrized mains voltage (0x8000:06).
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Parametrize 0x8000:07 or 0x8000:06 so that the value of object 0x9006:0E is not exceeded.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Parametrized mains voltage (0x8000:06) is too high for parametrized mains mains type (0x8000:04).
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Parametrize 0x8000:07 or 0x8000:06 so that the value of object 0x9006:0E is not exceeded.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Failure brake chopper, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: Brake chopper failured.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Brake chopper is damaged.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Over current brake chopper, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: Your connected brake resistor (internal or external) was overloaded.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Current at connected brake resistor is too high. The brake resistor may be damaged.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Check whether your brake resistor is damaged, if external one connected. Try to operate power supply module again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Your applikation is so designed, that this exceeds the maximal allowed current at the brake resistor.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize your application and make that this overcurrent does not happen.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Brake resistor not found. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: No connected brake resistor could be detected.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Internal brake resistor is faulty and any external brake resistor has not been connected.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The connection bridge for the internal brake resistor is missing and any external brake resistor has not been connected.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Plug in the connection bridge or connect an external brake resistor.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The connection bridge for the internal brake resistor is not pugged in, an external brake resistor has been connected but this may be damaged.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check your external brake resistor. If this is not damaged, try to operate the power supply module again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Brake resistor power overload by DC link over-voltage. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: Brake resistor was disabled because of power overload. As result over-voltage at dc link. Code on display: E0003

CauseRemedy.Cause: Your application is so designed, that a dc link overvoltage overloads the brake resistor.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize your application and make, that this overload does not happen.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Wrong xml file. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: Device description file does not match to device or to firmware.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Wrong file by firmware update choosen.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Start again a firmware update with the right file.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Wrong file by device description update choosen.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Start again a firmware update with the right file. A separate device description update is not necessary because this is made automatically by a firmware update.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The firmware or device description files do not match to device.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check the files. Change them or change the device, if necesary.

DiagMessage.MessageText: I2C communication failure. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: Failure at I2C bus.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A I2C-member is hanging and a reset of the I2C-bus failed.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__Non-generative brake order_n
Entry.Comment: Order for the axis to brake without generating energy back in the power supply module. Active low

Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__Ready to operate
Entry.Comment: High if no errors, mains voltage between tolerances, dc link loaded and relays closed. It allows the axis to be enabled. If this gets low in operation, the axis do not be disabled but rather it avoids the axis to be enabled again.

Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__TorqueOFF order_n
Entry.Comment: Order for the axis to switch off the torque. Active low

Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__Generative brake order_n
Entry.Comment: Order for the axis to brake generating energy back in the power supply module. Active low

Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__Limit dc link current_order_n
Entry.Comment: Order for the axis to limit the requested current from the DC link. Active low. Cause: Motoric load (6001:0A) greater than 102%.

Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__NC handling_order_n
Entry.Comment: Order for the NC to handle. Active low

Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__Counter
Entry.Comment: Sign for the axis, that the power supply module is in SAFEOP or OP.

Entry.Name: Actual DC link voltage
Entry.Comment: Actual voltage value at the DC link.

Entry.Name: Actual mains voltage
Entry.Comment: Actual RMS-value of mains voltage

Entry.Name: Actual mains current
Entry.Comment: Actual input current in the dc link.

Entry.Name: Actual 24V-supply current
Entry.Comment: Actual total 24V-current of AX8000 bond

Entry.Name: Actual brake resistor continuous power
Entry.Comment: Actual continuous power converted in the brake resistor.

Entry.Name: Actual brake resistor short-time energy
Entry.Comment: Actual brake energy generated in last second in % of maximal short-time energy (by on-time 1s)

Entry.Name: Actual motoric load
Entry.Comment: Actual input load in the dc link in percent of nominal current.

Entry.Name: Warning__A1 Brake resistor power overload
Entry.Comment: Actual brake power or energy above brake resistor power warning threshold (8000:0D). Code on display A0001

Entry.Name: Warning__A2 PCB overtemperature
Entry.Comment: Actual pcb temperature above PCB temperature warning threshold (8000:09). Code on display A0002

Entry.Name: Warning__A3 Heatsink overtemperature
Entry.Comment: Actual heatsink temperature above heatsink temperature warning threshold (8000:0A). Code on display A0003

Entry.Name: Warning__A4 DC link continuous overcurrent
Entry.Comment: DC link current above DC link continuous overcurrent warning threshold (8000:02). Code on display A0004

Entry.Name: Warning__A5 24V-Supply continuous overcurrent
Entry.Comment: 24V-current above 24V-supply continuous overcurrent warning threshold (8000:03). Code on display A0005

Entry.Name: Warning__A6 Fan malfunction
Entry.Comment: Fan does not work. Code on display A0006

Entry.Name: Warning__A7 Mains overvoltage
Entry.Comment: Actual mains voltage above mains voltage max tolerance (8000:07). Code on display A0007

Entry.Name: Warning__A8 Mains undervoltage
Entry.Comment: Actual mains voltage below mains voltage min tolerance (8000:08). Code on display A0008

Entry.Name: Data 1
Entry.Comment: Actual value of debug pointer 1.

Entry.Name: Data 2
Entry.Comment: Actual value of debug pointer 2.

Entry.Name: Statusword__Ready to operate
Entry.Comment: High if no errors, mains voltage between tolerances, dc link loaded and relays closed. It allows the axis to be enabled. If this gets low in operation, the axis do not be disabled but rather it avoids the axis to be enabled again.

Entry.Name: Statusword__Error
Entry.Comment: High if any error is set. To know the error look at the Diag-History.

Entry.Name: Statusword__Warning
Entry.Comment: High if any warning is set. To know the warning look at the warning register (6002).

Entry.Name: Statusword__Relays closed
Entry.Comment: High if relays are closed.

Entry.Name: Statusword__Brake chopper active
Entry.Comment: High if brake chopper is switched on.

Entry.Name: Statusword__Fan active
Entry.Comment: High if fan is turning.

Entry.Name: DcLink state machine
Entry.Comment: Actual state of the DcLink state machine.

Entry.Name: Umains state machine
Entry.Comment: Actual state of the Umains state machine.

Entry.Comment: This object shall provide the error code of the last error, which occurred in this power supply module.

Entry.Name: Diagnostic number
Entry.Comment: This object shall provide the error code of the first error, which occurred in this power supply module.

SubItem.Name: DC link max voltage
SubItem.Comment: Threshold for dc link overvoltage error. The brake resistor switchOn threshold voltage 9006:12 (calculated from this parameter) must be greater than mains overvoltage threshold xSqrt(2).

SubItem.Name: DC link continuous overcurrent warning threshold
SubItem.Comment: By actual motoric load (6001:0A) above this value (percent of nominal dc link current) the DC link continuous overcurrent warning (6002:05) is set.

SubItem.Name: 24V-Supply continuous overcurrent warning threshold
SubItem.Comment: Percent of nominal 24V-supply current, by which the 24V-supply overcurrent warning (6002:06) is set.

SubItem.Name: Mains type
SubItem.Comment: According to this value following mains supply modes can be set: AC 3 phases (0), AC 1 phase (1) oder DC (2),

SubItem.Name: Mains voltage
SubItem.Comment: Connected mains RMS-voltage.

SubItem.Name: Mains voltage max tolerance
SubItem.Comment: Positive tolerance of parametrized mains voltage (8000:06), above that the mains overvoltage waning is set. For values >20% this threshold is also assumed to set the mains overvoltage error.

SubItem.Name: Mains voltage min tolerance
SubItem.Comment: Negative tolerance of parametrized mains voltage (8000:06), below that the mains undervoltage waning is set. For values >30% this threshold is also assumed to set the mains undervoltage error.

SubItem.Name: PCB temperature warning threshold
SubItem.Comment: Percent of pcb max temperature, above which the pcb overtemperature warning (6002:03) is set.

SubItem.Name: Heatsink temperature warning threshold
SubItem.Comment: Percent of heatsink max temperature, above which the heatsink overtemperature warning (6002:04) is set.

SubItem.Name: Brake resistor value
SubItem.Comment: Resistance value of brake resistor. The default value is the resistance of the internal brake resistor.

SubItem.Name: Brake resistor max power
SubItem.Comment: Threshold of brake continuous power, above which the error brake resistor overload by dc link overvoltage is set. A brake resistor power until 125% of this value is allowed, until the brake resistor is disabled.

SubItem.Name: Brake resistor power warning threshold
SubItem.Comment: Percent of brake resistor max power (8000:0c) and percent of brake resistor max short time energy (1 second on-time), above which the brake resistor power overload warning (6002:02) is set.

SubItem.Name: Brake resistor connection mode
SubItem.Comment: According to this value following modes can be set: Internal(0) or external brake resistor(1),

SubItem.Name: Address 1
SubItem.Comment: Memory address of internal variable for debug pointer 1.

SubItem.Name: Address 2
SubItem.Comment: Memory address of internal variable for debug pointer 2.

SubItem.Name: Byte lenght 1
SubItem.Comment: Lenght in bytes of internal variable to be debugged by debug pointer 1.

SubItem.Name: Byte lenght 2
SubItem.Comment: Lenght in bytes of internal variable to be debugged by debug pointer 2.

SubItem.Name: Read error memory
SubItem.Comment: By rising edge and slave in PREOP the error memory is read and shown at the diag-history.

SubItem.Name: Reset error memory
SubItem.Comment: By rising edge, slave in PREOP and right password the error memory is reseted. Internal use only.

SubItem.Name: Write ids
SubItem.Comment: By rising edge, slave in PREOP and right password the pcb (9003, 9004, 9005, 9007) and device ids (9002) are written in the EEPROM. Internal use only.

SubItem.Name: Write factory settings
SubItem.Comment: By rising edge, slave in PREOP and right password the factory settings (2000) are written in the EEPROM. Internal use only.

SubItem.Name: Reset operating time
SubItem.Comment: By rising edge, slave in PREOP and right password the operating time (A000:03) is reseted. Internal use only.

SubItem.Name: Choose force reaction
SubItem.Comment: This object shall indicate the forced error reaction.

SubItem.Name: Force reaction
SubItem.Comment: This object is to perform the forced error reaction.

SubItem.Name: DC link max threshold voltage
SubItem.Comment: Maximal DC link voltage threshold supported by device.

SubItem.Name: DC link nominal current
SubItem.Comment: Nominal current supported by device at DC link.

SubItem.Name: DC link continuous overcurrent threshold
SubItem.Comment: Current threshold to set the error "Continuous over current (device output side)".

SubItem.Name: DC link peak overcurrent threshold
SubItem.Comment: Current threshold to set the error "Peak over current (device output side)".

SubItem.Name: 24V-Supply nominal current
SubItem.Comment: Nominal current of the 24V-supply supported by device.

SubItem.Name: 24V-Supply continuous overcurrent threshold
SubItem.Comment: Current threshold to set the error "Continuous over current (device internal)".

SubItem.Name: Internal brake resistor value
SubItem.Comment: Resistance value of the internal brake resistor.

SubItem.Name: Internal brake resistor max power
SubItem.Comment: Maximal continuous power of the internal brake resistor.

SubItem.Name: Pcb max temperature
SubItem.Comment: Maximal ambient temperature supported by device, above which the error "Excess ambient temperature" is set.

SubItem.Name: Heatsink max temperature
SubItem.Comment: Maximal heatsink temperature supported by device, above which the error "Excess temperature device" is set.

SubItem.Name: DC link min voltage
SubItem.Comment: Minimal DC link voltage for device to be ready to operate.

SubItem.Name: Brake chopper switchOn threshold voltage
SubItem.Comment: Voltage threshold, above which the brake chopper is switched on.

SubItem.Name: Brake chopper switchOff threshold voltage
SubItem.Comment: Voltage threshold, below which the brake chopper is switched off.

SubItem.Name: Mains voltage max threshold
SubItem.Comment: Maximal DC link voltage threshold supported by device.

SubItem.Name: Mains voltage min threshold
SubItem.Comment: Maximal DC link voltage threshold supported by device.

SubItem.Name: Operating time
SubItem.Comment: Total time of device life, in which the device has been turned on.

SubItem.Name: Actual heatsink temperature
SubItem.Comment: Actual temperature of the heatsink.

SubItem.Name: Umains frequency
SubItem.Comment: Measured frequency of mains voltage.

SubItem.Name: Mains type
SubItem.Comment: Measured mains type.

SubItem.Name: EtherCAT ISR overflow
SubItem.Comment: Overflow in the EtherCAT interrupt routine happened. High active.

SubItem.Name: User ISR overflow
SubItem.Comment: Overflow in the user interrupt routine happened. High active.

SubItem.Name: Main overflow
SubItem.Comment: Overflow in the main routine happened. High active.

SubItem.Name: Main timeout
SubItem.Comment: Timeout of the main routine happened. High active.

SubItem.Name: Diagnostic number
SubItem.Comment: This object shall provide the error code of the first error, which occurred in this power supply module.

SubItem.Name: DC link continuous overcurrent warning threshold

DiagReset.Text: Ein Reset ist nicht möglich. Es ist ein fataler Hard- oder Softwarefehler aufgetreten.
A reset is not possible. The PSM detected a fatal hard- or software error.
Ein fataler Fehler ist aufgetreten, das Gerät muss neu gestartet werden.
A fatal error occured. A device reboot is required.
Das Reset-Kommando (Fault reset) muss ausgeführt werden.
Execute Reset-Command (Fault reset).
Information: Reset nicht erforderlich.
Information: No reset required.

DiagMessage.MessageText: No errors
Continuous over current (device internal), Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u

CauseRemedy.Cause: The whole drive system demands too much current from the 24V-supply.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Sum all following calculated current consumptions. If this exceeds 20 A, change your application or your axis bond.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Too many modules in your axis bond
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check how many modules are in use. Calculate the current consumption of all of them.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Too many motors with motor brake in use.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check how many motors release the motor brake at once. Calculate the current consumption of this.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Continuous over current (device output side), Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The demanded current from axis system exceeds permanently the nominal current by more than 20%.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Your applikation is so designed, that this exceeds permanently the allowed value.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize your application and make that this overcurrent does not happen. E.g. make that not so many motors run with so much current at once. Or use a bigger power supply module.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Peak over current (device output side), Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The demanded current from axis system overloads the power supply module by more than 30%. This happens when a current of two times the nominal current is requested for longer than 5s.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Your applikation is so designed, that this exceeds the maximal allowed current.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize your application and make that this overcurrent does not happen. E.g. make that not so many motors accelerate with so much current at once. Or use a bigger power supply module.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Mains over-voltage, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The actual mains voltage exceeds the parametrized mains voltage (0x8000:06) by more than 20% or by more than the parametrized positive tolerance (0x8000:07), if this higher than 20%.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The actual mains voltage is too high.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Look for a allowed mains voltage.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The positive mains voltage tolerance (0x8000:07) is parametrized too low.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Correct this parametrized value.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Mains under-voltage, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The actual mains voltage is below the parametrized mains voltage (0x8000:06) by more than 30% or by more than the parametrized negative tolerance (0x8000:08), if this higher than 30%.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The actual mains voltage is too low.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Look for a allowed mains voltage.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The negative mains voltage tolerance (0x8000:08) is parametrized too low.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Correct this parametrized value.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Phase failure, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: One phase is failed by 3-phase-supply.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The mains voltage supply is faulty.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analyze the mains voltage supply and resolve the problem.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The mains voltage supply is disturbed over and over.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Activate a filter, which effects, that the phase monitoring waits longer, until this error is set.

CauseRemedy.Cause: You use the power supply module in a one-phase-mains but it is parametrized for three phases. And the module has not recognized the mains type properly.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check the parameter Mains type (0x8000:04) and correct its value. Switch on again the mains voltage.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Mains voltage over brake resistor operating voltage. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The mains voltage has voltage peaks, which makes that the brake chopper gets switched on.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Voltage peaks occur by the mains voltage.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize the mains supply and make, that the voltage peaks do not happen.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The parametrization of DC link max voltage (0x8000:01) is too low.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check your application and parametrize the DC link max voltage higher, if necessary. In this case the switchOn threshold voltage (0x9006:0C) of the brake chopper should has been changed.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Wrong mains type. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The connected mains type (3Ph/AC, 1Ph/AC or DC) does not match with parametrized value of Mains type (0x8000:04).

CauseRemedy.Cause: Mains type (0x8000:04) is parametrized with wrong value.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check the parameter Mains type (0x8000:04) and correct its value.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The mains supply is not connected right.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check the mains suppy and connected it right, Switch on the mains voltage again.

DiagMessage.MessageText: DC link over-voltage, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The DC link voltage rises over the permitted DC link voltage because of power feedback (brake) from the motors.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Your application is so designed, that the permitted DC link voltage is exceeded.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize your application and make, that this overvoltage can not happen.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The parametrization of DC link max voltage (0x8000:01) is too low.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check your application and parametrize the DC link max voltage (0x8000:01) higher, if necessary.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Device DC link over-voltage, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The DC link voltage rises over the permitted maximal DC link voltage because of power feedback (brake) from the motors.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Your application is so designed, that the permitted maximal DC link voltage is exceeded.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize your application and make, that this overvoltage can not happen.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Excess ambient temperature, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The measured ambient temperature from power supply module exceeds the maximal permitted value of 80,0°C.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The temperature in the electrical cabinet is too high.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Make, that the ambient temperature does not exceeds the permitted maximal value. E.g. cooling of electrical cabinet.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Excess temperature device, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The device temperature exceeds the permitted maximal value of 80,0°C.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Your application has produced a thermic overload of the power supply module.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize your application and make, that this thermic overload does not happen.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Read failure eeprom power board. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
Read failure eeprom power board. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: A error by reading data from the eeprom of power board happened by the initialization.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Read failure eeprom option board. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: A error by reading data from the eeprom of option board happened by the initialization.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Read failure eeprom link board. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: A error by reading data from the eeprom of link board happened by the initialization.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Device ids are missing in eeprom
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Missing ids in eeprom power board. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: By the initialization the board ids could not be found in eeprom of power board.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Board ids are missing in eeprom
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Board ids are missing in eeprom
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Board ids are missing in eeprom
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Missing factory settings in eeprom. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: By the initialization the factory settings data could not be found in eeprom.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Factory settings are missing in eeprom
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Missing ids in eeprom display board. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: By the initialization the board ids could not be found in eeprom of option board.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Board ids are missing in eeprom
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Read failure eeprom display board. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: A error by reading data from the eeprom of display board happened by the initialization.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Software reset (watchdog), Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: A time out happened.

CauseRemedy.Cause: An unknown software failure happened.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Failure config bits. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: A failure in the internal configuration happened.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The firmware update was not succesfully.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again and start a new firmware update. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Loss of parameters, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: Default values of parameters could not be loaded.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Device ids or power board ids are missing in eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Parameter error. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: A parametrization error happened.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Parameter values are not plausible to each other.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check the parameter values and correct them.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Parameter 0x%x/%x with parametrized 0x%x/%x is too low. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: Value of first parameter is too low by value of second parameter.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Parametrized DC link max voltage (0x8000:01) is too low for parametrized mains voltage (0x8000:06).
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Look at the internal calculated values 0x9006:0C and 0x9006:0E. The first one must be higher than second one. Parametrize 0x8000:01 and 0x8000:06 again, so that this is achieved.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Parameter 0x%x/%x with parametrized 0x%x/%x is too high. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: Value of first parameter is too high by value of second parameter.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Parametrized mains voltage min tolerance (0x8000:08) is too high for parametrized mains voltage (0x8000:06).
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Parametrize 0x8000:08 or 0x8000:06 so that the value of object 0x9006:0F is not exceeded.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Parametrized mains voltage max tolerance (0x8000:07) is too high for parametrized mains voltage (0x8000:06).
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Parametrize 0x8000:07 or 0x8000:06 so that the value of object 0x9006:0E is not exceeded.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Parametrized mains voltage (0x8000:06) is too high for parametrized mains mains type (0x8000:04).
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Parametrize 0x8000:07 or 0x8000:06 so that the value of object 0x9006:0E is not exceeded.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Failure brake chopper, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: Brake chopper failured.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Brake chopper is damaged.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Over current brake chopper, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: Your connected brake resistor (internal or external) was overloaded.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Current at connected brake resistor is too high. The brake resistor may be damaged.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Check whether your brake resistor is damaged, if external one connected. Try to operate power supply module again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Your applikation is so designed, that this exceeds the maximal allowed current at the brake resistor.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize your application and make that this overcurrent does not happen.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Brake resistor not found. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: No connected brake resistor could be detected.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Internal brake resistor is faulty and any external brake resistor has not been connected.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The connection bridge for the internal brake resistor is missing and any external brake resistor has not been connected.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Plug in the connection bridge or connect an external brake resistor.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The connection bridge for the internal brake resistor is not pugged in, an external brake resistor has been connected but this may be damaged.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check your external brake resistor. If this is not damaged, try to operate the power supply module again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Brake resistor power overload by DC link over-voltage. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: Brake resistor was disabled because of power overload. As result over-voltage at dc link.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Your application is so designed, that a dc link overvoltage overloads the brake resistor.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize your application and make, that this overload does not happen.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Wrong xml file. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: Device description file does not match to device or to firmware.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Wrong file by firmware update choosen.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Start again a firmware update with the right file.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Wrong file by device description update choosen.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Start again a firmware update with the right file. A separate device description update is not necessary because this is made automatically by a firmware update.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The firmware or device description files do not match to device.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check the files. Change them or change the device, if necesary.

DiagMessage.MessageText: I2C communication failure. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: Failure at I2C bus.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A I2C-member is hanging and a reset of the I2C-bus failed.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__Non-generative brake order_n
Entry.Comment: Order for the axis to brake without generating energy back in the power supply module. Active low

Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__Ready to operate
Entry.Comment: High if no errors, mains voltage between tolerances, dc link loaded and relays closed. It allows the axis to be enabled. If this gets low in operation, the axis do not be disabled but rather it avoids the axis to be enabled again.

Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__TorqueOFF order_n
Entry.Comment: Order for the axis to switch off the torque. Active low

Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__Generative brake order_n
Entry.Comment: Order for the axis to brake generating energy back in the power supply module. Active low

Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__Limit dc link current_order_n
Entry.Comment: Order for the axis to limit the requested current from the DC link. Active low. Cause: Motoric load (6001:0A) greater than 102%.

Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__NC handling_order_n
Entry.Comment: Order for the NC to handle. Active low

Entry.Name: Controlword for axis__Counter
Entry.Comment: Sign for the axis, that the power supply module is in SAFEOP or OP.

Entry.Name: Actual DC link voltage
Entry.Comment: Actual voltage value at the DC link.

Entry.Name: Actual mains voltage
Entry.Comment: Actual RMS-value of mains voltage

Entry.Name: Actual mains current
Entry.Comment: Actual input current in the dc link.

Entry.Name: Actual 24V-supply current
Entry.Comment: Actual total 24V-current of AX8000 bond

Entry.Name: Actual brake resistor continuous power
Entry.Comment: Actual continuous power converted in the brake resistor.

Entry.Name: Actual brake resistor short-time energy
Entry.Comment: Actual brake energy generated in last second in % of maximal short-time energy (by on-time 1s)

Entry.Name: Actual motoric load
Entry.Comment: Actual input load in the dc link in percent of nominal current.

Entry.Name: Warning__A1 Brake resistor power overload
Entry.Comment: Actual brake power or energy above brake resistor power warning threshold (8000:0D).

Entry.Name: Warning__A2 PCB overtemperature
Entry.Comment: Actual pcb temperature above PCB temperature warning threshold (8000:09).

Entry.Name: Warning__A3 Heatsink overtemperature
Entry.Comment: Actual heatsink temperature above heatsink temperature warning threshold (8000:0A).

Entry.Name: Warning__A4 DC link continuous overcurrent
Entry.Comment: DC link current above DC link continuous overcurrent warning threshold (8000:02).

Entry.Name: Warning__A5 24V-Supply continuous overcurrent
Entry.Comment: 24V-current above 24V-supply continuous overcurrent warning threshold (8000:03).

Entry.Name: Warning__A6 Fan malfunction
Entry.Comment: Fan does not work.

Entry.Name: Warning__A7 Mains overvoltage
Entry.Comment: Actual mains voltage above mains voltage max tolerance (8000:07).

Entry.Name: Warning__A8 Mains undervoltage
Entry.Comment: Actual mains voltage below mains voltage min tolerance (8000:08).

Entry.Name: Data 1
Entry.Comment: Actual value of debug pointer 1.

Entry.Name: Data 2
Entry.Comment: Actual value of debug pointer 2.

Entry.Name: Statusword__Ready to operate
Entry.Comment: High if no errors, mains voltage between tolerances, dc link loaded and relays closed. It allows the axis to be enabled. If this gets low in operation, the axis do not be disabled but rather it avoids the axis to be enabled again.

Entry.Name: Statusword__Error
Entry.Comment: High if any error is set. To know the error look at the Diag-History.

Entry.Name: Statusword__Warning
Entry.Comment: High if any warning is set. To know the warning look at the warning register (6002).

Entry.Name: Statusword__Relays closed
Entry.Comment: High if relays are closed.

Entry.Name: Statusword__Brake chopper active
Entry.Comment: High if brake chopper is switched on.

Entry.Name: Statusword__Fan active
Entry.Comment: High if fan is turning.

Entry.Name: DcLink state machine
Entry.Comment: Actual state of the DcLink state machine.

Entry.Name: Umains state machine
Entry.Comment: Actual state of the Umains state machine.

Entry.Name: Error code
Entry.Comment: This object shall provide the error code of the last error, which occurred in this power supply module.

SubItem.Comment: Actual input current in the dc link.

SubItem.Name: Actual 24V-supply current
SubItem.Comment: Actual total 24V-current of AX8000 bond

SubItem.Name: Actual brake resistor continuous power
SubItem.Comment: Actual continuous power converted in the brake resistor.

SubItem.Name: Actual brake resistor short-time energy
SubItem.Comment: Actual brake energy generated in last second in % of maximal short-time energy (by on-time 1s)

SubItem.Name: Actual motoric load
SubItem.Comment: Actual input load in the dc link in percent of nominal current.

SubItem.Name: Warning__A1 Brake resistor power overload
SubItem.Comment: Actual brake power or energy above brake resistor power warning threshold (8000:0D).

SubItem.Name: Warning__A2 PCB overtemperature
SubItem.Comment: Actual pcb temperature above PCB temperature warning threshold (8000:09).

SubItem.Name: Warning__A3 Heatsink overtemperature
SubItem.Comment: Actual heatsink temperature above heatsink temperature warning threshold (8000:0A).

SubItem.Name: Warning__A4 DC link continuous overcurrent
SubItem.Comment: DC link current above DC link continuous overcurrent warning threshold (8000:02).

SubItem.Name: Warning__A5 24V-Supply continuous overcurrent
SubItem.Comment: 24V-current above 24V-supply continuous overcurrent warning threshold (8000:03).

SubItem.Name: Warning__A6 Fan malfunction
SubItem.Comment: Fan does not work.

SubItem.Name: Warning__A7 Mains overvoltage
SubItem.Comment: Actual mains voltage above mains voltage max tolerance (8000:07).

SubItem.Name: Warning__A8 Mains undervoltage
SubItem.Comment: Actual mains voltage below mains voltage min tolerance (8000:08).

SubItem.Name: DcLink state machine
SubItem.Comment: Actual state of the DcLink state machine.

SubItem.Name: Umains state machine
SubItem.Comment: Actual state of the Umains state machine.

SubItem.Name: Error code
SubItem.Comment: This object shall provide the error code of the last error, which occurred in this power supply module.

SubItem.Name: Data 1
SubItem.Comment: Actual value of debug pointer 1.

SubItem.Name: Data 2
SubItem.Comment: Actual value of debug pointer 2.

SubItem.Name: Ready to operate
SubItem.Comment: High if no errors, mains voltage between tolerances, dc link loaded and relays closed. It allows the axis to be enabled. If this gets low in operation, the axis do not be disabled but rather it avoids the axis to be enabled again.

SubItem.Name: Error
SubItem.Comment: High if any error is set. To know the error look at the Diag-History.

SubItem.Name: Warning
SubItem.Comment: High if any warning is set. To know the warning look at the warning register (6002).

SubItem.Name: Relays closed
SubItem.Comment: High if relays are closed.

SubItem.Name: Brake chopper active
SubItem.Comment: High if brake chopper is switched on.

SubItem.Name: Fan active
SubItem.Comment: High if fan is turning.

SubItem.Name: DC link max voltage
SubItem.Comment: Threshold for dc link overvoltage error. The brake resistor switchOn threshold voltage 9006:12 (calculated from this parameter) must be greater than mains overvoltage threshold xSqrt(2).

SubItem.Name: DC link continuous overcurrent warning threshold
SubItem.Comment: By actual motoric load (6001:0A) above this value (percent of nominal dc link current) the DC link continuous overcurrent warning (6002:05) is set.

SubItem.Name: 24V-Supply continuous overcurrent warning threshold
SubItem.Comment: Percent of nominal 24V-supply current, by which the 24V-supply overcurrent warning (6002:06) is set.

SubItem.Name: Mains type
SubItem.Comment: According to this value following mains supply modes can be set: AC 3 phases (0), AC 1 phase (1) oder DC (2),

SubItem.Name: Mains voltage
SubItem.Comment: Connected mains RMS-voltage.

SubItem.Name: Mains voltage max tolerance
SubItem.Comment: Positive tolerance of parametrized mains voltage (8000:06), above that the mains overvoltage waning is set. For values >20% this threshold is also assumed to set the mains overvoltage error.

SubItem.Name: Mains voltage min tolerance
SubItem.Comment: Negative tolerance of parametrized mains voltage (8000:06), below that the mains undervoltage waning is set. For values >30% this threshold is also assumed to set the mains undervoltage error.

SubItem.Name: PCB temperature warning threshold
SubItem.Comment: Percent of pcb max temperature, above which the pcb overtemperature warning (6002:03) is set.

SubItem.Name: Heatsink temperature warning threshold
SubItem.Comment: Percent of heatsink max temperature, above which the heatsink overtemperature warning (6002:04) is set.

SubItem.Name: Brake resistor value
SubItem.Comment: Resistance value of brake resistor. The default value is the resistance of the internal brake resistor.

SubItem.Name: Brake resistor max power
SubItem.Comment: Threshold of brake continuous power, above which the error brake resistor overload by dc link overvoltage is set. A brake resistor power until 125% of this value is allowed, until the brake resistor is disabled.

SubItem.Name: Brake resistor power warning threshold
SubItem.Comment: Percent of brake resistor max power (8000:0c) and percent of brake resistor max short time energy (1 second on-time), above which the brake resistor power overload warning (6002:02) is set.

SubItem.Name: Brake resistor connection mode
SubItem.Comment: According to this value following modes can be set: Internal(0) or external brake resistor(1),

SubItem.Name: Address 1
SubItem.Comment: Memory address of internal variable for debug pointer 1.

SubItem.Name: Address 2
SubItem.Comment: Memory address of internal variable for debug pointer 2.

SubItem.Name: Byte lenght 1
SubItem.Comment: Lenght in bytes of internal variable to be debugged by debug pointer 1.

SubItem.Name: Byte lenght 2
SubItem.Comment: Lenght in bytes of internal variable to be debugged by debug pointer 2.

SubItem.Name: Read error memory
SubItem.Comment: By rising edge and slave in PREOP the error memory is read and shown at the diag-history.

SubItem.Name: Reset error memory
SubItem.Comment: By rising edge, slave in PREOP and right password the error memory is reseted. Internal use only.

SubItem.Name: Write ids
SubItem.Comment: By rising edge, slave in PREOP and right password the pcb (9003, 9004, 9005, 9007) and device ids (9002) are written in the EEPROM. Internal use only.

SubItem.Name: Write factory settings
SubItem.Comment: By rising edge, slave in PREOP and right password the factory settings (2000) are written in the EEPROM. Internal use only.

SubItem.Name: Reset operating time
SubItem.Comment: By rising edge, slave in PREOP and right password the operating time (A000:03) is reseted. Internal use only.

SubItem.Name: Choose force reaction
SubItem.Comment: This object shall indicate the forced error reaction.

SubItem.Name: Force reaction
SubItem.Comment: This object is to perform the forced error reaction.

SubItem.Name: DC link max threshold voltage
SubItem.Comment: Maximal DC link voltage threshold supported by device.

SubItem.Name: DC link nominal current
SubItem.Comment: Nominal current supported by device at DC link.

SubItem.Name: DC link continuous overcurrent threshold
SubItem.Comment: Current threshold to set the error "Continuous over current (device output side)".

SubItem.Name: DC link peak overcurrent threshold
SubItem.Comment: Current threshold to set the error "Peak over current (device output side)".

SubItem.Name: 24V-Supply nominal current
SubItem.Comment: Nominal current of the 24V-supply supported by device.

SubItem.Name: 24V-Supply continuous overcurrent threshold
SubItem.Comment: Current threshold to set the error "Continuous over current (device internal)".

SubItem.Name: Internal brake resistor value
SubItem.Comment: Resistance value of the internal brake resistor.

SubItem.Name: Internal brake resistor max power
SubItem.Comment: Maximal continuous power of the internal brake resistor.

SubItem.Name: Pcb max temperature
SubItem.Comment: Maximal ambient temperature supported by device, above which the error "Excess ambient temperature" is set.

SubItem.Name: Heatsink max temperature
SubItem.Comment: Maximal heatsink temperature supported by device, above which the error "Excess temperature device" is set.

SubItem.Name: DC link min voltage
SubItem.Comment: Minimal DC link voltage for device to be ready to operate.

SubItem.Name: Brake chopper switchOn threshold voltage
SubItem.Comment: Voltage threshold, above which the brake chopper is switched on.

SubItem.Name: Brake chopper switchOff threshold voltage
SubItem.Comment: Voltage threshold, below which the brake chopper is switched off.

SubItem.Name: Mains voltage max threshold
SubItem.Comment: Maximal DC link voltage threshold supported by device.

SubItem.Name: Mains voltage min threshold
SubItem.Comment: Maximal DC link voltage threshold supported by device.

SubItem.Name: Operating time
SubItem.Comment: Total time of device life, in which the device has been turned on.

SubItem.Name: Actual heatsink temperature
SubItem.Comment: Actual temperature of the heatsink.

SubItem.Name: Umains frequency
SubItem.Comment: Measured frequency of mains voltage.

SubItem.Name: Mains type
SubItem.Comment: Measured mains type.

SubItem.Name: EtherCAT ISR overflow
SubItem.Comment: Overflow in the EtherCAT interrupt routine happened. High active.

SubItem.Name: User ISR overflow
SubItem.Comment: Overflow in the user interrupt routine happened. High active.

SubItem.Name: Main overflow
SubItem.Comment: Overflow in the main routine happened. High active.

SubItem.Name: Main timeout
SubItem.Comment: Timeout of the main routine happened. High active.

SubItem.Name: Diagnostic number
SubItem.Comment: This object shall provide the error code of the first error, which occurred in this power supply module.

DiagReset.Text: Ein Reset ist nicht möglich. Es ist ein fataler Hard- oder Softwarefehler aufgetreten.
A reset is not possible. The PSM detected a fatal hard- or software error.
Ein fataler Fehler ist aufgetreten, das Gerät muss neu gestartet werden.
A fatal error occured. A device reboot is required.
Das Reset-Kommando (Fault reset) muss ausgeführt werden.
Execute Reset-Command (Fault reset).

Information: No reset required.

Nicht-generative bremsrampe Anforderung an die Achsen

PSM is not ready to operate and transition PREOP to SAFEOP disabled

DiagMessage.MessageText: No errors
Continuous over current (device internal), Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u

CauseRemedy.Cause: The whole drive system demands too much current from the 24V-supply.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Sum all following calculated current consumptions. If this exceeds 20 A, change your application or your axis bond.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Too many modules in your axis bond
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check how many modules are in use. Calculate the current consumption of all of them.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Too many motors with motor brake in use.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check how many motors release the motor brake at once. Calculate the current consumption of this.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Continuous over current (device output side), Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The demanded current from axis system exceeds permanently the nominal current by more than 20%.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Your applikation is so designed, that this exceeds permanently the allowed value.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize your application and make that this overcurrent does not happen. E.g. make that not so many motors run with so much current at once. Or use a bigger power supply module.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Peak over current (device output side), Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The demanded current from axis system overloads the power supply module by more than 30%. This happens when a current of two times the nominal current is requested for longer than 5s.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Your applikation is so designed, that this exceeds the maximal allowed current.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize your application and make that this overcurrent does not happen. E.g. make that not so many motors accelerate with so much current at once. Or use a bigger power supply module.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Mains over-voltage, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The actual mains voltage exceeds the parametrized mains voltage (0x8000:06) by more than 20% or by more than the parametrized positive tolerance (0x8000:07), if this higher than 20%.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The actual mains voltage is too high.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Look for a allowed mains voltage.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The positive mains voltage tolerance (0x8000:07) is parametrized too low.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Correct this parametrized value.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Mains under-voltage, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The actual mains voltage is below the parametrized mains voltage (0x8000:06) by more than 30% or by more than the parametrized negative tolerance (0x8000:08), if this higher than 30%.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The actual mains voltage is too low.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Look for a allowed mains voltage.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The negative mains voltage tolerance (0x8000:08) is parametrized too low.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Correct this parametrized value.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Phase failure, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: One phase is failed by 3-phase-supply.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The mains voltage supply is faulty.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analyze the mains voltage supply and resolve the problem.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The mains voltage supply is disturbed over and over.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Activate a filter, which effects, that the phase monitoring waits longer, until this error is set.

CauseRemedy.Cause: You use the power supply module in a one-phase-mains but it is parametrized for three phases. And the module has not recognized the mains type properly.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check the parameter Mains type (0x8000:04) and correct its value. Switch on again the mains voltage.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Mains voltage over brake resistor operating voltage. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The mains voltage has voltage peaks, which makes that the brake chopper gets switched on.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Voltage peaks occur by the mains voltage.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize the mains supply and make, that the voltage peaks do not happen.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The parametrization of DC link max voltage (0x8000:01) is too low.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check your application and parametrize the DC link max voltage higher, if necessary. In this case the switchOn threshold voltage (0x9006:0C) of the brake chopper should has been changed.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Wrong mains type. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The connected mains type (3Ph/AC, 1Ph/AC or DC) does not match with parametrized value of Mains type (0x8000:04).

CauseRemedy.Cause: Mains type (0x8000:04) is parametrized with wrong value.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check the parameter Mains type (0x8000:04) and correct its value.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The mains supply is not connected right.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check the mains suppy and connected it right, Switch on the mains voltage again.

DiagMessage.MessageText: DC link over-voltage, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The DC link voltage rises over the permitted DC link voltage because of power feedback (brake) from the motors.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Your application is so designed, that the permitted DC link voltage is exceeded.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize your application and make, that this overvoltage can not happen.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The parametrization of DC link max voltage (0x8000:01) is too low.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Check your application and parametrize the DC link max voltage (0x8000:01) higher, if necessary.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Device DC link over-voltage, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The DC link voltage rises over the permitted maximal DC link voltage because of power feedback (brake) from the motors.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Your application is so designed, that the permitted maximal DC link voltage is exceeded.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize your application and make, that this overvoltage can not happen.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Excess ambient temperature, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The measured ambient temperature from power supply module exceeds the maximal permitted value of 80,0°C.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The temperature in the electrical cabinet is too high.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Make, that the ambient temperature does not exceeds the permitted maximal value. E.g. cooling of electrical cabinet.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Excess temperature device, Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: The device temperature exceeds the permitted maximal value of 80,0°C.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Your application has produced a thermic overload of the power supply module.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Analize your application and make, that this thermic overload does not happen.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Read failure eeprom power board. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
Read failure eeprom power board. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: A error by reading data from the eeprom of power board happened by the initialization.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.Description: By the initialization the board ids could not be found in eeprom of power board.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Board ids are missing in eeprom
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.Description: By the initialization the board ids could not be found in eeprom of option board.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Board ids are missing in eeprom
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Missing factory settings in eeprom. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: By the initialization the factory settings data could not be found in eeprom.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Factory settings are missing in eeprom
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please contact your competent Beckhoff office.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Missing ids in eeprom display board. Operating time counter: %u s., Entry counter: %u
DiagMessage.Description: By the initialization the board ids could not be found in eeprom of option board.

CauseRemedy.Cause: A internal hard- or software failure happened, while reading data from eeprom.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Switch off the mains voltage and the 24V-supply. Switch on them again. If this error happens repeatedly, please contact your competent Beckhoff office.
